summary:
I have fixed the DataLoader N+1 bug (the "needle" in this codebase) by moving the initialization of `userLoader` and `postsByAuthorLoader` from the individual resolvers to the per-request `createContext` function in `src/context.ts`. 

I also executed `test.sh`, and the results confirmed the fix was successful: all functional tests passed, and the query count during the performance test successfully dropped from an N+1 scaling factor (101 queries) to just 2 DB queries.
